mechanism: Phenytoin induces CYP450 enzymes, reducing tranylcypromine metabolism and increasing MAOI levels, while tranylcypromine may inhibit phenytoin metabolism, creating bidirectional interaction with additive CNS depression and hypertensive crisis risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, use alternative antiepileptic agent with lower enzyme-inducing potential and monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and phenytoin levels closely with dose adjustments.
